sprint: INSPECT-0 Source Register + Dutch Profile Design; INSPECT-1A Corrections-Only Source And Claim Hygiene; INSPECT-2 Bounded Pilot Evidence Audit; INSPECT-2A Profile Adjustment Before Schema Design; INSPECT-3 Report-Only Schema Design; INSPECT-4 Report-Only Validator Design; INSPECT-5 Strictly Non-Blocking Validator Refinement; INSPECT-5R External Review, Privacy, And Claim Guardrails; INSPECT-6 Report-Only Generator Planning; INSPECT-7 Dutch Scoped Evidence-Pack Prototype
product_boundary: This profile defines evidence that 4veco can expose to support school/provider inspection preparation. It is not a compliance certificate and does not replace school implementation evidence or competent-authority judgement. Every category must preserve a boundary between 4veco product evidence, school-owned evidence, and forbidden inferences.
exercise_first_boundary: Inspection standards may identify evidence categories and quality requirements, but they do not mint MTUs, target exercises, procedures, lesson goals, or student-facing content. Real CvTE tasks, correction models, reviewed target exercises, and built paragraph target exercises remain stronger curricular evidence.
evidence_strength_order: official CvTE exam questions and correction models
generated student-facing paragraph artifacts verified in 4veco-lessen
diagnostic reports that cite source or review artifacts
safe_claims: 4veco is designed to expose product evidence relevant to Dutch VO inspection preparation.

4veco can help teachers and schools organise product-side evidence for curriculum coherence, subject-relevant basic-skills support, didactic design, assessment alignment, student support, accessibility, and product quality assurance.
4veco's Dutch evidence profile maps product evidence to inspection-relevant categories without claiming inspection approval, legal compliance, or complete school-level evidence.
4veco exposes subject_material_basic_skills_evidence relevant to OP0 basic-skills preparation without claiming complete OP0, school-wide basic-skills, or citizenship-curriculum proof.
forbidden_claims: 4veco is compliant with Dutch inspection standards.
4veco is approved by the Dutch Inspectorate of Education.
4veco materials by themselves satisfy a school's inspection obligations.
Inspection prose authorises new economics lesson units or target exercises.
4veco provides complete OP0/basic-skills evidence for a school or department.
A migrated target exercise is final-reviewed curriculum evidence.
Screenshot QA proves full accessibility compliance.

categories.label: Curriculum offer
dutch_inspection_anchor: OP0 Basisvaardigheden where the offer concerns Dutch language, mathematics/arithmetic, and citizenship
known_gaps_or_weaknesses: Coverage reports are not yet an inspection-specific evidence pack.
The model must distinguish planned coverage from generated, reviewed lesson evidence.
Foreign curriculum mappings are not authorised in this Dutch profile.
Migrated target exercises must not be reported as final-reviewed curriculum evidence.
Target exercises without exam-code links remain weaker curriculum-alignment evidence.
Generated lesson artifact presence must be separated from reviewed lesson artifact quality.
categories.school_implementation_boundary: The school remains responsible for its full curriculum plan, scheduling, classroom implementation, and local policy choices.

product_school_boundary.4veco_evidence: Blueprints, chapter/paragraph plans, target-exercise records, generated lesson folders, and reviewed lesson-quality records where present.
product_school_boundary.school_owned_evidence: Full curriculum plan, scheduling, classroom implementation, and local policy choices.
product_school_boundary.forbidden_inference: Do not infer final-reviewed curriculum evidence from migrated target-exercise presence alone.

categories.label: Basic skills
4veco_evidence_targets: citizenship and economic participation contexts where relevant
known_gaps_or_weaknesses: OP0 evidence is not yet exposed as a dedicated Dutch inspection profile.
Citizenship/economic participation evidence is likely contextual and should not be overstated.
Language-reasoning evidence needs careful distinction between Dutch-language skill and economics answer construction.
This is subject-material basic-skills evidence, not complete OP0 evidence.
This is not school-wide Dutch-language, mathematics/arithmetic, or citizenship implementation proof.
Citizenship contexts must remain contextual unless explicit reviewed citizenship-curriculum evidence exists.
categories.school_implementation_boundary: 4veco can expose subject-material evidence; the school must show deliberate curriculum choices and classroom practice across all basic skills.

product_school_boundary.4veco_evidence: Economics reasoning, calculation, graph/table/source interpretation, and answer construction inside reviewed product material.
product_school_boundary.school_owned_evidence: School-wide Dutch language, mathematics/arithmetic, citizenship curriculum, classroom practice, and deliberate implementation evidence.
product_school_boundary.forbidden_inference: Do not state that 4veco provides complete OP0 evidence or school-wide basic-skills proof.

categories.label: Didactic quality
dutch_inspection_anchor: OP1 Aanbod where learning progression and provision are inspected
4veco_evidence_targets: student-visible route from Start to Check
known_gaps_or_weaknesses: Rendered student-route proof is currently bounded and not broad product proof.
Some companion/check surfaces remain under controlled-scope review rather than scale-ready status.
PASS WITH FLAGS is useful evidence but is not an unconditional final pass.
categories.school_implementation_boundary: The product can provide didactic materials; the school must show actual teacher practice, adaptation, and classroom interaction.

product_school_boundary.4veco_evidence: Paragraph plans, procedure routes, worked examples, guided practice, dual-coding evidence, quality-ref records, companion reviews, and Part A reviews.
product_school_boundary.school_owned_evidence: Actual teacher practice, adaptation, lesson execution, and classroom interaction.
product_school_boundary.forbidden_inference: Do not flatten PASS WITH FLAGS into an unconditional PASS or a Boolean true.

categories.label: Student development and support
dutch_inspection_anchor: OP2 Zicht op ontwikkeling en begeleiding
OP3 where support affects didactic action
known_gaps_or_weaknesses: 4veco must avoid diagnostic, mastery, automatic sequencing, or summative claims.
Short-check and exit-ticket surfaces are not complete across all paragraphs.
Practice routes and checks must be distinguished from school-owned monitoring and support decisions.
Advisory checks must not be counted as target-equivalent closure proof unless reviewed as such.
categories.school_implementation_boundary: Student monitoring, care plans, support decisions, and intervention records are school-owned evidence, not product-owned evidence.

product_school_boundary.4veco_evidence: Practice routes, hints, route panels, prerequisite checks, advisory checks, and remediation/enrichment suggestions inside the product.
product_school_boundary.school_owned_evidence: Student monitoring, care plans, accommodations, interventions, and support decisions.
product_school_boundary.forbidden_inference: Do not count every check as closure proof or as school-owned student-support evidence.

categories.label: Assessment and closure
dutch_inspection_anchor: OP1/OP3 where assessment alignment supports offer and didactic quality
known_gaps_or_weaknesses: Official correction-model ingestion is not yet fully represented.
Exit-ticket target-equivalent proof remains controlled and incomplete across the first-three-paragraph product proof set.
Assessment evidence must remain local and non-summative unless later gates authorise broader claims.
Target exercise presence is not the same as target-equivalent closure proof.
Answer-model presence is not the same as reviewed exit-ticket proof.
Local reviewed target-equivalent proof is not the same as generalised semantic scoring proof.
categories.school_implementation_boundary: School summative assessment policy, PTA/transition decisions, and formal grading remain school responsibilities.

product_school_boundary.4veco_evidence: Target exercises, answer models, local target-equivalent proof records, rubrics/correction guidance, and official correction-model decomposition where available.
product_school_boundary.school_owned_evidence: Formal assessment policy, grading, PTA, promotion/transition decisions, and summative closure.
product_school_boundary.forbidden_inference: Do not infer closure evidence from target-exercise or answer-model presence alone.

categories.label: Accessibility and inclusion
dutch_inspection_anchor: Cross-cutting evidence for student access, support, and didactic quality
known_gaps_or_weaknesses: Accessibility evidence is currently review/proof-artifact based, not an inspection-specific profile.
Mobile/dark-mode proof can be route-specific and should not be generalised.
Screenshot QA is not full accessibility proof.
Accessibility evidence must be split into sub-evidence labels before broad reporting.
categories.school_implementation_boundary: The school remains responsible for individual accommodations, device access, and inclusive classroom implementation.

product_school_boundary.4veco_evidence: Alt text, visual/layout review, contrast/theme checks, mobile layout proof, keyboard/focus evidence, semantic structure evidence, inclusive language review, and absence of internal-code exposure where reviewed.
product_school_boundary.school_owned_evidence: Individual accommodations, device access, school accessibility policy, and inclusive classroom implementation.
product_school_boundary.forbidden_inference: Do not treat screenshot QA or route-local proof as full accessibility compliance.

categories.label: Quality assurance
dutch_inspection_anchor: SKA quality assurance standards at governance level
Evidence supporting systematic school/product quality development
known_gaps_or_weaknesses: Generated reports are diagnostic and not primary evidence.
Inspection evidence is not yet integrated into a report-only validator or teacher pack.
Generated reports must remain diagnostic evidence unless they cite source or review artifacts.
Future evidence records should distinguish primary source artifacts, review records, diagnostic reports, and generated dashboard projections.
categories.school_implementation_boundary: School governance, self-evaluation, improvement planning, and inspection conversations remain school-owned.

product_school_boundary.4veco_evidence: Quality-ref YAML, review records, validators, sprint reports, lead reviews, closure logs, and full platform validation evidence.
product_school_boundary.school_owned_evidence: School governance, self-evaluation, school quality assurance, improvement planning, and inspection conversations.
product_school_boundary.forbidden_inference: Do not treat product QA records as school SKA compliance evidence.

categories.label: Improvement cycle
known_gaps_or_weaknesses: Inspection-specific improvement logs do not exist yet beyond INSPECT-0 setup logs.
Future evidence packs must separate product improvement from school improvement.
Product improvement evidence may support school preparation but does not replace school self-evaluation, school quality assurance, or inspection dialogue.
categories.school_implementation_boundary: A 4veco issue/review cycle can support but cannot replace the school's own quality cycle.

product_school_boundary.4veco_evidence: Sprint records, human gates, correction loops, lead reviews, carried flags, validation logs, and next-action records.
product_school_boundary.school_owned_evidence: School self-evaluation, governance quality cycle, board-level accountability, and inspection dialogue.
product_school_boundary.forbidden_inference: Do not present product improvement cycles as school SKA evidence.

profile_adjustment_basis.approved_next_action: INSPECT-2A Profile Adjustment Before Schema Design
profile_adjustment_basis.purpose: Adjust profile language before schema design so future reports distinguish artifact presence, reviewed quality, target-exercise finality, target-equivalent proof, diagnostic report status, and product evidence versus school-owned implementation evidence.

required_audit_notes.requirement: Every pilot or report must cite the live blueprint title and flag title mismatches between human review text, target registry, chapter plan, and lesson folder.
required_audit_notes.reason: Title mismatch is a traceability issue, not a reason to audit the wrong paragraph.

required_audit_notes.requirement: Target exercise presence is not target-equivalent closure proof; answer-model presence is not reviewed exit-ticket proof; local reviewed proof is not generalised semantic-scoring proof.
Reports can guide reviewers to evidence, but reports are diagnostic unless they cite source or review artifacts.
Every category must explicitly state 4veco evidence, school-owned evidence, and forbidden inference.

subject_material_basic_skills_evidence.allowed_wording: 4veco exposes subject-material evidence relevant to OP0 basic-skills preparation.

target_equivalent_proof: Target exercise presence is not the same as target-equivalent closure proof.
Answer-model presence is not the same as reviewed exit-ticket proof.
Local reviewed proof is not the same as generalised semantic scoring proof.
reporting_boundaries.diagnostic_reports: Generated reports and dashboards are diagnostic evidence unless they cite primary source artifacts or review records.
reporting_boundaries.pass_with_flags: PASS WITH FLAGS remains a distinct review outcome and must not be flattened into an unconditional PASS or Boolean true.

schema_design_authorization.accepted_prior_sprint: INSPECT-2A Profile Adjustment Before Schema Design
schema_design_authorization.required_wording: This schema is report-only and diagnostic. It does not create a quality gate, compliance claim, or generated-output mutation path.

minor_guardrails: The validator may check schema conformance and known forbidden phrases, but it must not claim complete semantic detection of unsafe compliance claims.
If the validator supports both pilot and full-report modes, only full-report mode may require all eight category records.
Schema validity and evidence strength are separate. Weak evidence can be valid evidence.

validator_refinement_authorization.purpose: Remove ambiguity between full JSON Schema validation and focused report-only contract validation before any generator planning.
validator_refinement_authorization.chosen_refinement_path: schema-backed report-only contract validation for the features used by references/schemas/inspection-evidence.schema.json, with explicit invalid-status wording and no production integration
validator_refinement_authorization.invalid_status_meaning: SCHEMA_INVALID_REPORT_ONLY means invalid against the schema-backed report-only inspection-evidence contract checked by the manual validator; it is not a build, dashboard, Scale Gate, quality-ref, compliance, or inspectorate judgement.

generator_planning_authorization.purpose: Use the accepted report-only generator plan, source contract, validation/dispatch plan, safe-claim boundaries, privacy no-personal-data default, and teacher-facing output shape to prototype one bounded evidence pack.
